verdict.rationale: CoreWeave offers CKS, a managed Kubernetes service on bare metal with node pools, autoscaling, and Terraform/API/CLI management, plus SUNK which runs managed Slurm jobs inside Kubernetes so platform engineers get both scheduler options without building on raw nodes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Slurm/Kubernetes scheduling at scale and more detail on SUNK's job submission workflow beyond docs claims.
